description: Coverage family "rests": every rest value (breve..64th), dotted and double-dotted rests, whole-bar rests in 16 meters, multi-bar rests (H-bar and church-rest symbols), raised / lowered rests in two-voice staves, rests inside tuplets and under beams, rests in the piano left hand and in a string quartet. Each item: engraving.ly, truth.musicxml (MusicXML 4.0, XSD-valid), clean.pdf, scan.pdf (typical scan), scan-severe.pdf (heavy damage), meta.json, ATTRIBUTION.txt.
counting_rules:
* an "event" is a <note> without <chord/> together with the <chord/> notes that follow it;
    note-<type>, chord, dot, double-dot, stem-*, flag, grace count events; ledger-* and tie count
    note heads
  * note-<type>: non-grace, non-cue pitched events by <type>; rests are not notes
  * dot / double-dot: events (notes AND rests, grace excluded) with exactly 1 / 2 <dot/>
  * beam: beam groups (<beam number="1">begin</beam>); flag: unbeamed events of eighth or shorter
  * ledger-above / ledger-below: note heads at staff position >= +6 / <= -6 (they need ledger lines)
  * rest-<type>: <rest/> without measure="yes", by <type>; rest-dotted: such rests with >= 1 dot
  * rest-whole-bar: <rest measure="yes"/> outside a multi-bar rest block; rest-multibar: blocks
    (<multiple-rest>); the bars inside a block are not counted again
  * clef-*: every <clef> element (initial and changes); clef-change: <clef> after the first measure
  * key-0 / key-sN / key-fN, time-*: every <key> / <time> element; *-change: after the first measure
  * system-break / page-break: <print new-system/new-page> (first part only)
  * x-rest-raised / x-rest-lowered: rests with <display-step>/<display-octave> above / below the middle
    line (the normal position); x-rest-in-tuplet: rests with <time-modification>; x-rest-in-beam: rests
    inside an open beam group of their voice; x-rest-fermata: rests with <fermata>;
    x-rest-multibar-symbols / x-rest-multibar-hbar: <multiple-rest use-symbols="yes"/"no">;
    x-rest-whole-bar-shared-staff: whole-bar rests in a measure where another voice of the same staff
    has notes or rests

items.title: Hocket for Two Flutes: raised and lowered rests on one staff

expected.notes: 12 bars, ONE part (instrumental staff "Flutes 1.2") with two voices: voice 1 stems up, voice 2 stems down. Every rest of voice 1 is raised (quarter/eighth/16th/half/dotted-quarter rests at the F5 position, whole-bar rests hanging from the top line), every rest of voice 2 lowered (E4 position, whole-bar rests hanging from the bottom line). The voices alternate (hocket), so most rests of one voice sound against notes of the other; bars 8 and 10 have rests in both voices at once and bar 9 a whole-bar rest in each voice. A converter should keep one part with two voices and assign each rest to its voice by its height.

items.title: Rests in Tuplets and Beams (flute)

expected.notes: 12 bars. Rests at the start, middle and end of tuplets: eighth triplets (1, 8), quarter triplets (2), 16th quintuplets and sextuplets (3), septuplets (4), 16th triplets (8), duplets in 6/8 (9) and a quadruplet (12). items.title: Quartet Fughetta: rests in a string quartet
